{{Short description|Software product developed by AnalystSoft}}
'''StatPlus''' is a [[software]] product developed by AnalystSoft for basic univariate and multivariate [[statistical analysis]] ([[MANOVA]], [[General linear model|GLM]], [[Latin square]]s), as well as [[time series]] analysis, [[nonparametric statistics]], [[survival analysis]] and statistical charts including [[control chart]]s.
It was originally developed for use in [[biomedical science]]s and known as BioStat. It is nowadays mostly used in biomedicine and [[natural science]]s.{{citation needed|date=September 2014}}

The software has a version for the [[Mac OS X]] known as StatPlus:mac.<ref>{{cite news | author=Michael Shaw | title=AnalystSoft's StatPlus:mac | url=http://www.mause.ca/about/dclick_issues/dc0805_s.pdf | format=PDF | work=DoubleClick | publisher=Macintosh Users East (MaUsE) | pages=20–21 | date=May 2008 | accessdate=2008-06-14 }}</ref>
This version may also be used as an add-on (software)  to [[Microsoft Excel]], similar to Microsoft's Analysis Toolpak on Windows.<ref>{{cite web | url=http://macresearch.org/review-statplusmac | title=A review of StatPlus:mac | accessdate=2008-06-15 | author=drc | date=2008-04-30 | publisher=MacResearch.org }}</ref>
